messages:
Marin (EncOps): running the staged CMK rotation sim in staging, found a restore failure for tenant-staging-4. snapshot decrypt failed with AccessDenied on kms:Decrypt. attaching small log snippet.
Sam: can you paste the exact error? might be grant expiry or an RBAC removal.
Marin (EncOps): ```
2026-03-20T14:02:11Z RestoreTask-98f: DecryptError: AccessDeniedException: User arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/staging-backup-uploader/i-0a1b2c3d4e cannot decrypt with key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01
    at KMS.Decrypt (kms_client.go:87)
```
Lee: looks like the ephemeral grant for `staging-backup-uploader` was not re-applied after we removed that role from the bucket policy in last week's RBAC cleanup. cc @Ash who merged the change. :eyes:
Ash: yep that was my PR (#1472) — I removed a long-unused binding. didn't realize the uploader role was still used for snapshot restores in staging. my bad. :grimacing:
encops-bot: rotation-sim completed — results: 5/6 decrypts OK, 1/6 failed (tenant-staging-4). full report uploaded to S3: s3://encops-sims/2026-03-20/5225009876-report.json
Sam: actionable items: 1) re-add the minimal grant for uploader to staging KMS as a temporary hotfix, 2) run a smoke restore, 3) update post-rotation checklist + add an automated audit that verifies `kms:Decrypt` CloudTrail events for any restore job.
Marin (EncOps): proposed quick grant command (AWS):
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id abcd-ef01 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/staging-backup-uploader --operations Decrypt --name "staging-restore-temp-grant"
```
Sam: also adding this to the playbook: after rotation run `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time yyyy-mm-ddT...` to confirm activity. for GCP backups use: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt"' --limit=50`.
sec-oncall: can we also include the grant-id in snapshot metadata so we can map restore failures -> missing grant quicker? + an alert rule: if RestoreTasks show DecryptError > 1 in 1h, page sec-oncall and encops.
Lee: agree. I'll open two follow-ups: (a) tiny metadata change to include `kms_grant_id` on snapshot objects, (b) alert + CloudTrail smoke job that runs post-rotation.
Ash: pushing hotfix grant now, will post status.
Marin (EncOps): thank you — once hotfix confirmed we'll kick an automated restore-run. recording this as a rotate-sim incident and adding to the rotation checklist PR. lessons: ephemeral grants are great but we need a deterministic verification step and better RBAC-change cross-team signoff. :memo:
